keep_intent: Compact benchmark dataset package retaining only dataset definitions, introduced-marker provenance, genome membership, completeness metadata, and final summary tables.

50gen.event_tables: exact scenario events copied from benchmark manifests
50gen.completeness_metric: truth-marker panel completeness derived from scenario reference_run marker_count_matrix.csv

100gen.event_tables: reconstructed from contaminant headers in retained run proteomes files
100gen.completeness_metric: truth-marker panel completeness derived from retained run marker_count_matrix.csv
limitations: Original source benchmark manifests/events for the 100-gen proof suite were no longer present locally when this package was built.
Combined-scenario event type is not always recoverable per inserted contaminant from retained headers alone.
